price_book_title: Simply Stoll Orderbook (Stoll Glass Door orderbook 2025)
price_field_note: The Simply Stoll orderbook (publication #SLO20, Sept 2025 - July 2026) is a dealer order book. Each fireplace door model has a single simplified price column keyed to fireplace opening size tier (e.g. 28-38"w, Up to 48"w, Up to 58"w; refaces use overall firebox width). These printed prices are the dealer/wholesale base prices that include the listed standard mounting options and door styles per the Simplified Pricing program. They are stored in dealer_price; msrp left null (no retail/MSRP column is published). dealer_price below records the smallest/base opening-size tier; the full tier price ladder for each model is given in the notes field. Cabinet Mesh and Single Mesh upgrades add $195 each; finishes such as Antique/Satin Brass Overlay, Brushed Stainless, Antique Black/Steel carry per-model upcharges noted where shown. All doors quote 3-4 week production time.
